tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /'khor 'das dbyer med kyi lta ba'i snying po bsdus pa skal bzang snying gi bdud rtsi zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 'jam dbyangs bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gnas lugs zab mo la lta ba'i blo gros stsol/ de la dbu ma pa'i slob dpon rnams kyis/ kun rdzob kyi 'dod tshul mi 'dra ba du ma zhig bshad pa de thams cad bsdu na/ rags pa phyi'i dbu ma dang / phra ba nang gi dbu ma gnyis su 'du/ dang po ni/ dbu ma thal 'gyur ba'i lta ba sgra ji bzhin pa khas len pa ste/ bstan bcos chen po'i gzhung 'chad pa dang / rtsod pa chen po byung ba'i dus su grub mtha' 'di bzung nas shag bkye bar gsungs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ phyi rol snang ba thams cad sems su bsgrubs/ sems de nyid kyang mthar spros bral gyi ngang du 'jog pa ste/ dben pa'i gnas su rnal 'byor nyams su len pa la 'di nyid gtso bor byed par gsungs so/ /de yang jo bo rjes/ pha rol rgol ba bzlog pa dang / /bstan bcos chen po'i gzhung dang ni/ /rtsod pa chen po byung dus su/ /rags pa'i dbu ma'i gzhung smra bya/ /de nyid don la gtsor byed cing / /rnal 'byor nyams su len dus su/ /phra ba'i rnal 'byor bsgom par bya/ /'di ni zhal gyi gdams pa yin/ /ces gsungs/ rgyas pa ni/ jo bo nyid kyi dbu ma rin po che'i sgron me las bshad pa'i lung khungs dang bcas legs bshad gong ma'i dgongs rgyan las 'byung ngo / /des na rang lugs kyi lta ba 'khor 'das dbyer med ni lugs phyi ma 'di dang mthun par gsungs so/ /de ji ltar bsgom pa'i tshul ni thog mar khrid yig rnams las ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin snang srid 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang sems gcig nyid de dang der shar ba yin gyi sems las gzhan pa'i chos cung zad kyang med pa'i tshul lung rigs man ngag gsum gyis gtan la 'bebs tshul la/ dang po lung ni/ mdo sde sa bcu pa las/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag khams gsum po 'di dag ni sems tsam du zad do/

/zhes dang / rdo rje gur las/ rin chen sems las phyir gyur pa'i/ /sangs rgyas med cing gang zag med/ /rnam par shes pa'i gnas don rnams/ /phyi rol gyur pa cung zad med/ /ces dang / tshad ma rigs gter las/ don du snang ba blo nyid yin/ /snang ba 'di dag phyi na med/ /bag chags brtan dang mi brtan las/ /bden dang brdzun pa'i rnam bzhag byed/ /ces sogs shin tu mang ngo / /rigs pa ni/ don gcig yin ni tha dad phyir/ /don ma grub par 'dod pa yin/ /ces pa ltar chu phor gang la rigs drug gis mthong snang mi 'dra ba drug 'byung bas kyang snang ba phyi don du bden par ma grub par shes so/ /snang ba phyi don du bden par ma grub pa myong bas kyang grub ste/ sngon lam 'bras pa'i sgom chen zhig rtsa rlung gi byed pa la brten nas skom pa'i nyams byung bas/ chu 'thung 'dod pa na/ chu ra dang / chu mig dang / gtsang po na'ang chu mi snang bas the tshom skyes te/ chos gos gtsang po pha ri'i shing sdong zhig la bkal te log nas nyal bsdad/ nangs par skom pa'i nyams sangs pa na bltas pas chu ra dang / chu mig dang / gtsang po rnams na chu rgyun pa ltar babs 'dug chos gos len pa la ko ba btang dgos pa byung ba dang / yang rgya gar du rgan mo zhig la bu ma la shin tu gus pa zhig yod/ de yul phyogs gzhan zhig tu tshong la 'gro ba'i tshe/ kho rang gi chung ma la/ a ma la kha zas gtsang sbra dang ldan pa byin cig zer ba sogs kha ta zhib rgyas byas/ bus byes su yun ring 'gor ba'i tshe/ ma rgan mig la rab rib zhugs nas/ 'bras chan gyi nang la skra shad kyis gang bar mthong ba'i stobs kyis ma rgan pho ba skran nad kyis zin nas shin tu nyams thag par 'dug de nas bu slebs pa na/ a ma khyod la bsnyen bkur bzang po i byin smras pa na/ bu khyod rang song nas chung mas nga la za ma bzang po ye ma byin/ 'bras chan dang spu lud bsres nas byin pas rang la nad 'di byung smras pas/

bus chung ma la 'thab pa na/ chung mas ngas zas gtsang sbra ldan pa kho na byin kyang / ma 'di'i mig la rab rib zhugs yod pa 'dra/ khyod rang gis zan byin dang smras pas/ bus 'bras chan gtsang sbra dang ldan pa byin pa na/ bu khyod sngon chad nga la shin tu gus kyang / da ni khyod kyang chung ma'i dbang du song ba 'dra/ 'bras chan spu lud kyis gang 'dug zer bas/ bus mig la rab rib zhugs yod par shes nas/ a ma khyod rang gi mig la nad byung bas len/ 'bras chan 'di a ma khyod rang gis nyar tshags gyis smras/ sman pa bos nas mig nad bcos su bcug da 'bras chan la ltos dang smras pas/ spu nyag ma gcig kyang mi 'dug pas/ ma rgan gyis mig nad kyi rkyen gyis yin par nges shes snying nas skyes te/ nga la khog tu spu nyag ma gcig kyang ma song na nad yod don ci yod snyam nges shes skyes pas khog pa'i nad 'ja' yal ba ltar song ba'i lo rgyus ltar ro/ /bla ma brgyud pa na rim gyis bstan pa'i man ngag las 'byung ba ni/ sems la gnyid rdzas nad dang gdon gyis bslad/ /mig yor rab rib 'gal me myur 'khor ba/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /de ltar lung rigs man ngag gsum gyis bstan pa'i tshul la zhib tu bsam mno byas pas/ ji zhig na snang ba sems su rtogs pa 'byung ste/ dper na lan tshwa chu la thim pa na/ chu las zur du lan tshwa phye rgyu med pa bzhin sems las gzhan pa'i chos gang yang med par rtogs shing / tha na rang gi lus kyang zur du e yod mi shes pa'i nyams 'byung / de la snang sems 'dres pa mtshan nyid pa ni sa brgyad pa ma thob kyi bar mi 'byung bar gsungs pas/ gong gi de snang sems 'dres pa dngos ma yin kyang / rnal 'byor pa'i gnas skabs kyi nyams kyi 'char tshul tsam mo/ /'ga' zhig gis snang ba sems su bsgrubs pa ni dbu ma thal 'gyur ba'i lugs ma yin no/ /zhes zer ba ni shin tu mi 'thad de/ klu sgrub/ 'phags pa lha/

zla ba grags pa gsum kas snang ba sems yin par gsungs pas/ de rnams kyis thal 'gyur ba'i lta ba ma rtogs zhes smra i nus mtshar che'o/ /mkhas mchog mi pham rgya mtshos dbu ma rgyan 'grel du/ snang ba sems su sgrub pa 'di ni nang pa sangs rgyas pa rnams kyi grub mtha'i khyad chos/ dngos po'i gnas tshul gyi yin lugs/ sgom pa'i man ngag gi gnad dam pa/ srid pa'i 'khrul 'khor 'jig pa la shan pa srog gi gnad la mkhas pa dang / shing mkhan shing gi gnad la mkhas pa la sogs pa lta bu yin la/ thabs khyad par bas zin na mthar thug rdo rje theg pa'i skabs su'ang man ngag gnad kyi snying po'ang 'di kho na'o/ /zhes gsungs pa sogs snang ba sems su sgrub pa la bsngags pa shin tu mang po mdzad 'dug snang ba sems yin zer ba de'ang / rang snang sems yin zer ba yin gyi/ gzhan snang ni ma yin te/ thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyis/ rang sems du mar snang ba'i rang gnas su/ /rang rig sgyu ma'i skyes bu rang ngo shes/ /rang gzhan 'gag med rten 'brel rang ngos stong / /rang byung brjod med dbyings kyi rang zhal ltos/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /des na sems la sems kyis lta ba'i tshul gyis bltas pa na/ gsal le/ hrig ge ba ma 'gag par myong ba de nyid la gsal ba sems kyi mtshan nyid ces bya/ gsal tsam de nyid rang gi ngo bo'i sgo nas thog mar skye ba med pas skye ba'i rgyus stong / bar du gnas pa med pas gnas pa'i ngo bos stong / mthar 'gag pa med pas 'gag pa'i 'bras bus stong / kha dog dang dbyibs su ma grub/ lus kyi phyi nang bar gsum gang na yang mi gnas/ gang ltar btsal yang mi rnyed/ ci ltar brtags kyang ma grub pa de nyid la stong pa sems kyi rang bzhin zhes bya/ de ltar rang bzhin cir yang ma grub pa'i dus nyid na rang snang gi rtsal sna tshogs 'gag med du 'char bas gdod ma nas med ma myong / rang snang gi rtsal sna tshogs 'gag med du 'char ba'i dus nyid na rang bzhin cir yang ma grub pas gdod ma nas yod ma myong /

gdod ma nas yod ma myong ba'i rang bzhin stong pa dang / gdod ma nas med ma myong ba'i mtshan nyid gsal ba gnyis gdod ma nas 'bral ma myong bas rang snang du gsal le ba/ rang stong du sang nge ba/ rang rig tu rjen ne ba/ de nyid so so rang gi rig pa'i ye shes kyis nyams su myong bar bya ba tsam las don dam gshis lugs la ngo bo ngos gzung med/ blos gzung du med/ tshig gis brjod du med kyang / tha snyad kun rdzob tu 'jig rten gyi rmongs pa bsal ba'i phyir gnyis med ces bya/ zung 'jug ces bya/ brjod bral zhes bya/ bcos min sems kyi ngo bo zhes bya'o/ /de lta bu'i gnas lugs de 'khor 'das thams cad la khyab nas yod kyang / rang ngo rang gis ma shes pa rnams la 'khor ba pa zhes bya/ shes pa rnams la mya ngan las 'das pa zhes bya/ 'khor 'das zhes pa rtogs ma rtogs kyi ngos nas so sor bzhag pa tsam yin gyi gnas lugs rang ngos nas 'khor ba ngan pa zhig logs su spang rgyu med/ myang 'das bzang po zhig logs nas bsgrub rgyu med/ de legs par rtogs na 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi lta ba rtogs pa zhes bya ba yin no/ /mdor na rig pa gsal stong 'dzin med de nyid las g.yengs su ni nam yang med/ bsgom rgyu ni ci yang med pa'i ngang la rtsol med ma bcos lhug par bzhag ste/ rje btsun rin po che grags pa'i mgur las/ sems thog mar skye ba med par la/ /gnas pa dang 'gag pa ga la srid/ /skye 'gag med par bsam pa yang / /rnam rtog yin gyi zhog la thobs/ /bzhag pa rang yang zhog las med/ /'jog pa rang yang rnam rtog yin/ /zhes dang / mtha' bral zhes brjod yul las 'das/ /dbu ma sems tsam la sogs pa/ /tshig tu brjod pa spros pa yin/ /yid la bsam pa rnam rtog yin/ /rang byung gi gnas lugs ma rtogs shing / /'dzin med kyi gdams ngag ma goms pas/ /ji ltar bsam kyang 'dzin par song / /'dzin med bsams kyang 'dzin par song /

/gsal ba ma 'gag gi stong pa de/ /zung 'jug gi gnas lugs yin par go /zhes dang / rje sa paṇa gyis/ yod dang med pa la sogs pa/ /dngos po'i gnas lugs de la med/ /bsgom bya sgom byed la sogs pas/ /bsgom par bya ba yod ma yin/ /sems la ngo bo ma grub pas/ /sems kyi ngo sprod ga la yod/ /tshig gi yul las 'das pa'i phyir/ /brjod par bya ba ci yang med/ /ces gsungs/ mnyam bzhag de las langs pa na/ mig gi yul du gzugs gang dang gang mthong ba thams cad snang tsam nyid nas snang stong 'khor 'das dbyer med/ rna ba'i lam du sgra ci dang ci grags pa thams cad grags tsam nyid nas grags stong 'khor 'das dbyer med/ yid kyi yul du rnam rtog gang dang gang 'gyu ba thams cad 'gyus tsam nyid nas rig stong 'khor 'das dbyer med de/ gang shar chos sku'i yo langs/ gang snang 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi rol par shar nas tshong pa gser gling du phyin pa ltar sgom bya ba zur nas btsal ma dgos par gang shar gang snang de'i steng du bcas bcos ma byas par bzhag pas chog pa 'byung / gong gi snang grags rig gsum 'khor 'das dbyer med du bstan pa de la 'ga' res de ni sgom pa yin gyi/ lta ba min zer ba ni mi 'thad de/ rje btsun chen pos/ ljon shing chen mo dang dag ldan gnyis ka las/ chos can la 'khor ba dang / chos nyid la myang 'das/ de gnyis dbyer med pa la dbyer med du bzhag pa dang / 'jam dbyangs dkon mchog lhun grub kyis/ gang du'ang ma grub cir yang snang bas dngos/ /dngos po kun gyi rang bzhin nyams dga'i chos/ /chos dang chos can gnyis su med pa'i don/ /don dam mtha' bral lta ba rtogs par shog /ces gsungs pa sogs lung mang po'i don la dpyad pas 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi lta ba la the tshom med do/ /mdor na gzhi dus kyi chos sku sems nyid ma bcos gnyug mar gnas pa de/ lam dus kyi chos sku sems nyid ma bcos par bzhag pa'i thabs kyis nyams su blangs pas 'bras dus kyi chos sku sems nyid ma bcos pa'i rang ngo rjen par mthong ba la sangs rgyas zhes ming btags pa yin gyi/

sems las gzhan pa'i sangs rgyas shig ga shed yod na rang res len kyang mi thub blangs kyang 'dres par dka'/ mdor na rang ngo rang gis ma shes pa la sems can dang / rang ngo rang gis shes pa la sangs rgyas zhes btags par shes par bya'o/ /lta sgom spyod gsum zer ba'ang / gang zag gi rgyud la sbyor tshul 'dra min la gnas skabs su ming tha dad btags pa tsam ma gtogs don 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi lta ba gcig nyid yin te/ de'ang bla ma brgyud pa dang bcas pas ji ltar ngo sprad pa ltar/ yul snang sems su thag chod/ sems snang tsam de'ang sgyu mar ngo 'phrod/ sgyu ma de'ang rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba tsam du shes/ rten 'brel gyi don brjod pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral bar rtogs nas gnas lugs zab mo'i don la gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i nges shes rnyed pa ni lta ba/ de nyid sbyor ba'i chos gsum sngon du btang nas/ dngos gzhi'i chos gsum gyi sgo nas lta ba zab mo la mnyam par bzhag rjes kyi chos gsum gyis mthar brgyan nas nyams su len pa ni sgom pa/ dus rtag tu lta ba'i dran shes kyi rang tshugs ma shor bar byas nas/ phyi'i bar chad gdon gsum/ nang gi bar chad nad gsum/ gsang ba'i bar chad nyon mongs pa dug gsum 'jig rten gyi chos brgyad sogs chags sdang 'khrul rtog mtha' dag dang bsre zhing bsgoms pas bud shing ji tsam mang na me stobs che ba bzhin/ rkyen ngan bar chad sogs gzung 'dzin gyi rtog snang ji tsam rgod kyang lta ba'i rtsi dang ma bral bar byas pas 'khyags pa'i gong bu chu ru zhu ba bzhin de thams cad chos dbyings bde ba chen po'i yo lang du ngo 'phrod nas lta ba la bogs je cher thon pa ni spyod pa yin no/ /de ltar lta ba zab mo la nyams myong phyin ci ma log pa rgyud la skyes na nyon mongs pa thams cad kyi gnyen por 'gro ste/ de'ang / spyir ston pa thugs rje can gyis 'dod chags kyi gnyen po mi sdug pa/

zhe sdang gi gnyen po byams pa'i ting nge 'dzin/ gti mug gi gnyen po rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba lugs 'byung ldog tu sgom pa/ nga rgyal gyi gnyen po khams kyi rab dbye/ phrag dog gi gnyen po bdag gzhan mnyam pa sgom pa sogs tshul du ma gsungs kyang / mi sdug pas 'dod chags kho na la phan gyi/ zhe sdang zhi bar mi nus/ byams pas zhe sdang zhi yang / 'dod chags la mi phan/ lta ba zab mo la nges shes bcos ma ma yin pa skyes na nyon mongs pa thams cad kyi gnyen por 'gyur te/ dper na 'jig rten na sman dpa' bo chig thub ces bya ba nad thams cad kyi gnyen por 'gro ba zhig yod/ de bzhin du stong pa nyid kyi don phyin ci ma log par rtogs na nyon mongs pa thams cad kyi gnyen por 'gyur te/ kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po'i zhal snga nas/ mi sdug chu yis 'dod chags dri ma 'khrus kyang sdang ba'i brag ri bshig mi nus/ /byams pa'i me yis zhe sdang tshang tshing bsregs kyang chags pa'i dri ma 'khrus pa min/ /stong dang rten 'byung gcig par rtogs pa'i mtshon gyis skye ba'i 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i/ /las dang nyon mongs yal 'dab rgyas pa'i bdag lta'i ljon shing rtsad nas gcod par byed/ /ces gsungs pa ltar ro/ /lam gyi chos thams cad bsdu na pha rol tu phyin pa drug la 'du/ de'ang lta ba'i gnad phyin ci ma log par rtogs pa'i gang zag zhig la bde blag tu 'byung ste/ spyod 'jug las/ gal te 'gro ba dbul bor bas/ /zhes pa nas/ de dag don med gyi nar 'khyams/ /zhes pa'i bar shlau ka dgu'i don pha rol tu phyin pa drug phyi lus ngag gi steng na ci'ang med/ phar phyin drug nang sems kyi steng nas 'tshol dgos te/ de'ang / gtong sems snying nas bskyed pa sbyin pa/ gnod sems rtsad nas bcom pa tshul khrims/ khro sems rtsa ba nas bcom pa bzod pa/ dge la spro sems snying nas skyes pa brtson 'grus/

sems rtse gcig tu gnas pa bsam gtan/ sems kyi rang bzhin shes pa shes rab yin pas de dag kyang lta ba rnam par dag pa rgyud ldan gyi gang zag zhig la 'byung ngo / /jo bo rje dang rje btsun mi la ras pa gnyis kyis kyang de bzhin du gsungs so/ /de bzhin du rgyal ba yang dgon pas/ dge ba'i rang bzhin shes pa dge ba'i mchog /mi dge'i rang bzhin shes pa bshags pa'i mchog /ces gsungs pa ltar dge ba'i rang bzhin shes pa ni zag med kyi dge ba yin pas rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi rgyur 'gyur/ mi dge ba'i rang bzhin shes pa ni bshags pa'i mchog yin te/ thar pa chen po phyogs su rgyas pa'i mdo las/ gal te 'gyod tshangs byed 'dod na/ /drang por 'dug la yang dag ltos/ /yang dag mthong na rnam par grol/ /de ni 'gyod tshangs mchog yin no/ /zhes dang / slob dpon ārya de bas/ bsod nams chung bas chos 'di la/ /the tshom tsam yang za mi 'gyur/ /the tshom tsam zhig zos pa na/ /srid pa hrul por byed par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /'di dag tshul bzhin rgyud la skye ba la/ bsags sbyang la 'bad rtsol drag po byed pa dang / bla ma sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bor shes par byas nas mos gus kyi gdung ba drag pos gsol ba rtse gcig tu 'debs pa gnad du che ste/ bde mchog gi bshad rgyud rnal 'byor ma kun tu spyod pa'i rgyud las/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid/ /skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang / /bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku/ /rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud/ /ces dang / chos rje sa skya paṇḍi tas/ gang gis g.yo med khyod bsten pas/ /de la de ma thag byin rlobs/ /skad cig gcig gis rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /yang na phun tshogs thams cad 'grub/ /ces dang / rgyud las/ g.yo med mos gus zla drug gis/ /rdo rje 'chang gi sa thob 'gyur/ /zhes dang / 'brom ston gyis jo bo rje la/ bdag gis de snga byas pa'i chos rnams lam du song ngam ma song zhus pas/

khyed kyis bla ma se btsun gyi g.yog byas pa de lam du song / gzhan ma song gsungs/ yang 'brom gyis nged bod la sgom byed pa mang po yod kyang / yon tan khyad par can skyes pa cis kyang mi bdog de cis lan zhus pas/ theg chen gyi yon tan che skye chung skye thams cad bla ma kho nar brten nas skye ba yin pa la/ khyod bod la bla ma la tha mal pa'i 'du shes las med/ yon tan ci la skye/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs zab mo'i rang zhal mthong ba la bla ma'i rnal 'byor las lhag pa gang yang ma gsungs so/ /des na bla ma'i rnal 'byor la nyams len kha tsam min par byas pas/ bzod glags med pa'i mos gus kyi gdung shugs khong nas me ltar 'bar/ bla ma min pa bsam rgyu dang dran rgyu med/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyang rang gi bla ma'i sprul pa yin par go rgya bod kyi bla ma mkhas grub dam pa rnams kyi rnam thar ngo mtshar can ji tsam mthong zhing thos kyang rang gi bla ma'i sprul pa kho na yin par shes/ bla ma la ni dkon mchog gsum po ma lus pa 'dus pa'i ngo bor thag chod nas bla ma mchod phyir rang gi lus kyi sha khrag gtong yang snying mi tshim zhing / bla ma dran zhing gdung ba'i dbyangs kyis gsol ba 'debs pa'i tshe mig nas mchi ma char ltar 'bab/ sha rus zhig nas 'gro snyam byed pa'i gdung shugs drag po de lta bu dang ldan pas gsol ba 'debs nus na yun ring mi thogs par thos bsam sgom gsum mthar phyin 'gro bar the tshom med/ de ltar min par skabs rer bla ma dran yang / bla ma mkhyen zer ba'am/ gsol 'debs sad sud re bton nas tshar bar brtsi ba de 'dras ni lam zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor nyams su blangs pa'i go chod pa mi 'dra bas rang gis rang mi bslu ba'i nyams len rnam dag re mdzad pa legs so/ /mchog sprul thams cad mkhyen pa 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyis/

skyabs gnas thams cad bla ma'i ngo bor shes/ /dge sbyor thams cad bla ma'i lam du mthong / /'khor 'das thams cad bla ma'i rol par shar/ /snang srid bla mar 'char bar byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes gsungs pa lta bu zhig byung na lam zab bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi nyams len 'khrul med gdeng khel zhig byung ba yin no/ /zhes pa 'di ni thar rtse zhabs drung rin po che byams pa nam mkha' kun bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan sogs lam 'bras gsan pa po du ma zhig gis lta ba'i gnad 'gag nyid kyi sems la ji ltar shar ba rnams ma bcos lhug gsal du 'god dgos zhes yang yang bskul ngor/ shākya'i dge slong ngag dbang legs pas ngag nas ji skad smras pa rnams sde gzhung lung rigs sku skye kun dga' bstan pa'i nyi mas yi ge pa bgyis pa'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'o// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 8 sga ston ngag dbang legs pa/ 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi lta ba'i snying po bsdus pa/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 9
